notes.title: The dream goes free
notes.content:
[p]I started the dream project in order to understand technically why games[/p][p]were getting fuzzier and fuzzier and asking for higher requirements but[/p][p]the performance is every time worst. As a result we have this game that[/p][p]you can even play it in a steam deck, or get it to run in 4k with a non dedicated[/p][p]gpu as the 780m
[/p][p]There was plenty of stuff that i didn't understand about the market of not free games,[/p][p]1. Gamers want to test the waters first. Either you do a demo or make a beta .[/p][p]2. there is a lot of boring stuff highly demanded by the user, like control configurations.[/p][p]3. Even making a big game full of features, if there is no story line its very hard to[/p][p]gain user attention.[/p][p]4. A lot of people hate mix of art, i dont have the capabilities so ill buy assets[/p][p] or use mixamo for animations, think if you add enough stuff in will end up sitting xD.[/p][p]
[/p][p]All of them are valid points, but i dont have the capabilities with a fulltime job to pass those[/p][p]validation points in order to put a price in the game as my new understanding of the situation[/p][p][/p][p]i could come and say yeah buy my game am indie, i hate dlcs and microtransactions[/p][p]but its just fighting the fact that games are everywhere and a lot of them are free[/p][p][/p][p]Long story short dont buy the dream, it will be FREE  when  steam changes the type of the game, (it could be today but it depends on steam)[/p][p]Users that already bought the dream will have access to anything that they want (from the game features)[/p]
